What’s the difference between a vape pen and a cartridge?

A vape pen is a portable device that heats cannabis oil, concentrate, or distillate into vapor instead of smoke. Many Jersey City consumers prefer pens for the smoother inhale and reduced odor compared to smoking flower. Cartridges, by contrast, are pre-filled containers that attach onto a pen’s battery.
